p.atlas.story: Legends tell of a being who carries the sky on his shoulders. To him the burden is not weight, but destiny.
At first touch, the golden light of apricot rises. Like the warm trace the sun leaves before it sets. Coconut weaves a creamy layer;
Lily of the valley lies hidden at its heart. A divine purity, an unseen grace.
Then the darkness deepens. Cocoa takes the stage; dense, dark, almost ancient. Amber Xtreme magnifies the power, widens the aura, casts an invisible halo around you.
And sandalwood… Like the memory of the earth. Timeless. Unshakeable. Eternal.
p.atlas.love_title: “If you love these, Atlas is for you.”

quiz.r.devil: Night energy, a sexy aura, a sweet and intense signature. A pull that lingers in the mind, with cherry, white chocolate and passion flower.
quiz.r.barbaros: Fresh, sea-breezed, clean and modern. A signature for daytime and summer, with pineapple, sea salt and ambergris.
quiz.r.sahmaran: Mystical, exotic, floral yet deep… A mysterious aura of banana, frangipani, ambergris and sandalwood.
quiz.r.arora: Radiant, modern, lightly sweet and fresh. The Y2K + glow-up vibe in perfume form.
quiz.r.atlas: Powerful, woody, charismatic. The scent of quiet luxury.
